description: At 62c02cb1a, `with ^p <> r <- "ab" do dbg(r) end` fails: error[parse/expected-token]: unexpected item without a newline: Caret (at the `^`). Elixir prints "b". Fixture 00664 works around it with `with {:ok, ^p <> r} <- {:ok, s}`. Done when: a with clause whose pattern starts with `^` parses, an oracle fixture agrees on interp, run and build, and 00664 uses the direct form.
